summary.intent: Implement work package G for the callisto repo: support Changesets v3 prerelease cycles (pre.json with only mode and tag) so version, rerun and pre exit work instead of failing with E114. Also fix an earlier push of the F2 branch that had not landed.
summary.outcome: Implemented v3 archiving of applied changesets into .changeset/pre/, wrote an end-to-end CLI test of the full v3 cycle that passes, updated ADR 1 and the versioning spec, added a changeset, and passed pre-push, lint and doc-check gates. G is committed locally and not pushed; the full `just test` suite was started but its result is not shown. F2 (#567) was pushed explicitly and verified signed.

repo: With push.default=simple, a plain `git push` from a local branch whose name differs from its upstream fails silently; push explicitly with `git push origin <local>:refs/heads/<remote-branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`.
Work packages are developed in separate git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ (e.g. wp-f2-pending-release, wp-g-pre-v3).

Adding a field to VersionPlan (archived_changesets) requires updating every struct literal across tests and modules: release_preview.rs, apply/tests.rs, apply/preflight/tests.rs, commands/pr_body.rs, commands/snapshot.rs and commands/version.rs.
Callisto writes pre.json back in the shape it read it (v2 or v3), preserves unknown keys, and still writes v2 for cycles started with `pre enter`.
The release decision records moved changesets as consumed and verification (is_changeset_path in release_decision.rs) must accept .changeset/pre/ paths.

Specs and ADRs live in docs/adr/0001-changesets-compatible-change-records.md and docs/specs/versioning.json and must be updated alongside format changes; the gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint` and `just doc-check`, then `just test`.
The cargo wrapper script c.sh is used to run cargo/just commands, and `cargo run -- add --package ...` is used to create changesets.

code.finding: Aggregation now handles the v3 archive: it loads .changeset/pre/ as retained input and records newly applied changesets for archiving via new_pre_changesets/consumed handling.
Introduces ArchivedChangeset and an archived_changesets field on VersionPlan, re-exported from lib.rs.
New end-to-end test covering a v3 cycle: version, rerun with no reapply, beta.1 on a new note, pre exit producing stable 1.1.0 with the archive emptied.

workflow: Verify that a push actually landed with `git ls-remote` and compare against `git rev-parse` rather than trusting silent output piped through tail.
Use bulk sed edits to patch many struct literals, then rely on `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` to catch the remaining ones.
Use an end-to-end test with the real binary to validate a full lifecycle rather than only unit tests.
Check commit signature verification via `gh api .../commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason`.

friction: The earlier push of the F2 branch silently failed because of push.default=simple, and was only noticed after the lead pointed it out.
Missed struct literals for archived_changesets caused compile errors across multiple files, needing iterative cargo check runs.
The F1 test helper predated the subagent's PreState accessors and had to be fixed.
open_items: G is committed locally but intentionally not pushed until F1 and F2 merge.
The result of the final full `just test` run was not shown in the transcript and needs confirming.
